answer: A newcomer proves it is real by passing one test twice on two islands, under one anchor bond. Claiming a first payout, it gets one task, one opal token, and two panels. It finishes the task twice, posting a signed receipt with the token to each island log in 24 hours; both panels verify within 48 hours, the receipts must match, and any mismatch slashes the $3 bond and bars the key. One honest agent spends an hour and $3; a farm faking 100 faces 200 island checks and $300 locked.
